description: This file contains driver code for the MDIO interface of the Ralink MT7620 Ethernet switch. It includes functions for reading and writing PHY registers via MDIO, managing link status, and handling MDIO bus operations specific to the hardware.

methods.name: int mt7620_mii_busy_wait(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw)
methods.description: Waits for the MDIO interface to become available or times out.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_write(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 phy_addr,u32 phy_register,u32 write_data)
methods.description: Performs a low-level write operation to a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_read(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Performs a low-level read operation from a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_write(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: High-level function to write to a PHY register using mii_bus.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_read(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: High-level function to read from a PHY register using mii_bus.

methods.name: void mt7530_mdio_w32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a specific MDIO register of MT7530.

methods.name: u32 mt7530_mdio_r32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a specific MDIO register of MT7530.

methods.name: unsigned char * fe_speed_str(int speed)
methods.description: Converts link speed codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: int mt7620_has_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Checks whether any port on the switch has an active carrier.

methods.name: void mt7620_handle_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Updates the net device carrier status based on link state.

methods.name: void mt7620_print_link_state(struct fe_priv * priv,int port,int link,int speed,int duplex)
methods.description: Logs the current link state, speed, and duplex mode.

methods.name: void mt7620_mdio_link_adjust(struct fe_priv * priv,int port)
methods.description: Adjusts link state and carrier based on current PHY status.
